title: Backup and recovery in practice
intro: Always keep one copy off the network. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Weekly backup is ready
decisions.prompt: The weekly backup is ready. What do you do?

artifact.title: Weekly backup is ready
body: ARXIV-DISK: ten years of documents, 212 GB. You can remove the disk now.

decisions.explain: An ejected disk cannot be encrypted in the next attack.

decisions.title: Settings: Backup is off

artifact.title: Settings: Backup is off
body: Last backup: 143 days ago. Turn it on now?

decisions.explain: From now on, photos are copied automatically every night.

decisions.title: Restore check

artifact.title: Restore check
body: Restore one folder from the latest copy as a test?

decisions.explain: Only a copy that opens is a real copy.

decisions.title: Message from BuludXidmet
decisions.prompt: In the morning, a message like this arrives. What do you do with this message?

artifact.name: BuludXidmet
body: Your storage is full. Your photos will be deleted in 24 hours. Upgrade your plan: buludxidmet-plan.example.info

decisions.explain: This is a fake: a real service does not threaten to delete your photos in a day.

decisions.title: Upload the folder to your personal account?

artifact.title: Upload the folder to your personal account?

decisions.explain: If an extra copy is needed, technical support creates it in an approved place.
